title: [finding] A THIRD inline copy of the form-field authoring contract lives in apps/console FormPage.tsx — objectui#5040 converged only the app-shell two
body:
Found while implementing #5040 (PR #5537). Filed unassigned, for PM triage — not
worked on here: `apps/console` was outside that card's declared file surface and
is held by in-flight #5504.

## Mechanism

#5040 is written around **two** inline descriptions of one contract — the
metadata-admin form field authoring type — converging into one. Measured, there
are **three**:

| # | site | status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` — `FormFieldSpec` | converged by PR #5537 into the leaf `views/metadata-admin/form-spec.ts` |
| 2 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` — `WidgetProps.fieldSpec` | converged by PR #5537; now *is* `FormFieldSpec` |
| 3 | `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:278` — `interface FormFieldSpec` | **untouched** — a third independent declaration under the same name |

Site 3 declares its own `interface FormFieldSpec`, used at `:275`
(`fields: Array<string \| FormFieldSpec>`) and `:352` (`const override:
FormFieldSpec = …`). It is a separate, hand-written description of the same
authoring shape, under the same name, in a different package.

## Why this is worth a card rather than a shrug

The defect #5040 recorded was not that a key was missing — it was that **two
descriptions of one contract drifted**, and nothing could notice because each
was only ever checked against itself. PR #5537 removed one of the two seams. A
third declaration under the same name leaves the same failure mode available:
site 3 can drift from the app-shell surface exactly as site 2 did, and the
symptom would again be "the type rejects the configuration the runtime accepts",
which no runtime test can see.

Note site 3 was NOT the source of the `dependsOn` defect and does not have to
adopt the app-shell type as-is — whether these are one contract or two layers
(`apps/console` may legitimately author a narrower shape) is exactly the
question triage should settle, and the answer might be "declare them distinct
and rename one", not "merge".

## Severity note

Filed as an observation (`finding`, no `pm:queue`): there is no user-reachable
failure today. Recording it because the shape — one contract, several
independent descriptions — is the class this repo has repeatedly paid for, and
because a card written around "two copies" would read as complete while a third
stayed open. Severity is triage's call, not mine at filing time.

## Boundary

- Searched open issues before filing (`FormFieldSpec` / `FormPage.tsx` /
  console-duplicate phrasings) — no card covers site 3.
- Not a duplicate of #5040: that card's declared surface was
  `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**`, and it is landing the
  app-shell half only, which PR #5537 states in its scope section.
- #5504 is untouched by this report; it is named only because it currently holds
  `apps/console`.
